parsed.post: Significant improvement in Round 1: boosted DEPTH from 4 to 6, reducing val_bpb from 1.102 to 1.017. The model scales well with depth. I will now explore increasing the learning rate or adjusting the matrix learning rate to see if we can further accelerate convergence with this larger architecture.
